name: asbestos-projects-nys
description: Search active asbestos abatement projects in New York City

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/css dist/fonts && cp src/static/*.css node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css dist/css/ && cp -R src/static/fonts/. dist/fonts/ && cp src/static/index.html src/static/sw.js src/static/new-york.pmtiles.gz src/static/favicon.svg output.json projects.json dist/
scripts.build:static: npm run clean && npm run build:client && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:full: npm run clean && npm run build:node && npm run build:client && npm run copy-assets
scripts.refresh-data: npm run build:node && npm run scrape && npm run geocode && npm run fetch-acp7 && npm run build-projects-data && npm run build

author: Soeren Roerden
